summary: The cited HighBar native-asset plan and FSBar resource manifest select unmodified upstream Recoil2026.07.04 at de69361239d8c8b1012dba3f5aa3122954ea4da3, alongside separately pinned HighBar, FSBar, game SDP and map bytes. The FS-GG/RecoilEngine protected fork instead contains appended typed command-queue callback slots and an ABI layout test. Its available source is not proof that the selected stock executable contains those extensions. HighBar must distinguish the exact callback-capable lineage from the stock Lua-observer route before touching appended ABI fields. Source, retained binary, configured selection and actually loaded engine/plugin require separate correspondence. The cited manifest describes inputs and does not prove a completed image or B2 browser distribution.
title: Selected stock engine and organization engine fork are distinct
